name: a broken conditional chain as a const value
format:
const size = n > 1000 ? "a large number of things" : n > 100 ? "a medium number" : n > 10 ? "a few" : "hardly any";
size

name: a broken conditional chain inside an argument
format: describe(n > 1000 ? "a large number of things" : n > 100 ? "a medium number" : "a small number", n)

expect.formatted:
describe(
  n > 1000 ? "a large number of things"
  : n > 100 ? "a medium number"
  : "a small number",
  n,
)

name: a broken conditional chain as a lambda body
format: xs.map(x => x.score >= 90 ? "excellent work, well done" : x.score >= 70 ? "good work" : "needs practice")

expect.formatted:
xs.map(
  x =>
    x.score >= 90 ? "excellent work, well done"
    : x.score >= 70 ? "good work"
    : "needs practice",
)

name: a conditional in a then branch is not part of the chain
format:
const r = first ? second ? "both the first and the second of them" : "only the first one of them, not the second" : third ? "the third" : "none";
r

expect.formatted:
const r =
  first
    ? second ? "both the first and the second of them"
      : "only the first one of them, not the second"
  : third ? "the third"
  : "none";
r

name: a conditional test in an else branch keeps its parentheses
format:
const r = first ? "the first of them all" : (second ? third : fourth) ? "the second or third" : "none of them";
r

name: comments in a broken conditional chain
format:
const r = a // test a
  ? "the first of the branches" // then a
  : b ? "the second of the branches" : "the last of the branches";
r

name: a link that does not fit breaks alone
format:
const kind = n > 1000000 ? "more than a million items, which is a great many of them indeed" : n > 1000 ? "thousands" : "a few";
kind

name: one conditional that does not fit
format:

kind
